notes: *Whereon* fuses עַל with מָה under rule 30; the fronted *do* then belongs to the participle, since the interrogative already holds an English word of its own (rule 17's second limit).

The בְּ of בְּמָצוֹר is unrepresented, the ASV writing *abide the siege* with a bare object (rule 40), and the supplied *the* belongs to the noun under rule 15; the margin's *in the stronghold* was read and set aside under rule 38.
The waw takes the subordinator *that* written for it (rule 14/55).
